interpretation: Null. The baseline friction gap was -0.025 against absolute levels near 1.55 - indistinguishable from zero and opposite in sign to the Part I disparity - so there was no gap available to narrow. The CI is an order of magnitude wider than the effect. Transfer is untested, not refuted.
